description: Urban Development Authority - Establishment of One Stop Unit
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes a new regulatory framework and administrative procedures for development approvals under the Urban Development Authority Law, No. 41 of 1978. It outlines the powers, functions, and composition of a new One Stop Unit and its committees, creating a regulatory process for development applications. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it establishes statutory procedures and compliance requirements rather than focusing on government personnel changes or organizational structure.
